doc.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

title: Recording the Eddie Condon reunion concert in Syracuse
summary: Ten tickets sold turned into a mob; Rayhill taped it on an Ampex with one mic, and Kenny Davern saved it for Arbors.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: group.” Eddie got a great group, unbelievable. And it’d be interesting to you that we sold ten tickets.

And I’m apologizing to Eddie, I said I feel sorry, I said, “You’re going to play before ten people.” He says, “Don’t worry about it,” he says, “we’ll have a ball.” Well I went to get Eddie at the airport, I brought him, there was a mob scene. They were lined up around the block for tickets, they turned hundreds of people away, they had only so many seats in the auditorium. And he was great. He just, oh, I love the guy. I mean he said, “Is there a place that we can go have some fun?” I says, “Our house.” And we came back there and we had a wonderful time.
Wow. And how did you manage to record it? Were you planning to?
I asked at the studio, I had an Ampex tape recorder, which was very good. It really came out — that sound that you hear there is very good. Yeah.
How many mics did you have?
One mic. Well you know that also, with a band like that they know how to control their—
Oh they’re old pros. They did great. Yeah Lou McGarrity always knew how to get up close to the mic and Bernie Previn was unbelievable. It was just glorious, a glorious time.
Right. So then this tape sat around for quite a while, and then did Kenny take it to Arbors?

Kenny took it to Arbors, yeah. It got lost at one time. You know how those things happen. But Kenny saved it. He was really the one who saved it. It was kind of surprising the tape held up pretty well.
Yeah, ‘cause sometimes that tape can fall right apart when it gets that old.
Oh yeah but it had a good sound, it had a good sound.
That’s great. Gee I’m glad you were able to do that.
